evidence_slices.fact: Coordinates associated with the UPRN for every addressable location across Great Britain; updated every six weeks; CSV and GeoPackage; free to use for everyone.
UPRN is a unique persistent identifier for every addressable location; product contains the position of each AddressBase Premium record and is intended to link datasets using UPRN or point position.
Core fields are UPRN, X_COORDINATE, Y_COORDINATE, LATITUDE and LONGITUDE; GeoPackage records are point geometry in British National Grid.
Whole of Great Britain is supplied as a single CSV file or GeoPackage.

evidence_slices.source: OS Open UPRN release notes index
evidence_slices.fact: Public index explicitly lists February 2026 Epoch 125 and states the product is refreshed six-weekly in line with AddressBase Epoch dates.

guardrails: No individual UPRN value was invented.
No point geometry was fabricated without a source row.
No Internet Access coverage value was inferred.
No canonical parcel identity or local crosswalk result was claimed.
